newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 19.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
* New York State is offering companies pollution credits as a way to lure them to the state.
* Students graduating from U.S. colleges are finding an improved job market.
* Zaire rebels have taken control of Kinshasa, and Western military officers are eager to meet the commander of such a stunning accomplishment.
* The New York Knicks basketball team lost its playoff series against the Miami Heat. But it hit Knicks player Patrick Ewing perhaps the hardest.
* The Metropolitan Museum of Art has been promised 11 Chinese paintings from the C.C. Wang Family Collection.
* The Clinton administration is about to announce new rules governing large wire transfers to points outside the U.S. as a way to combat drug trafficking from Latin America.
